Excalidraw for CodeExpander
=====================================

A CodeExpander plugin that embeds Excalidraw.

Virtual collaborative whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn like diagrams.

----------

CodeExpander Excalidraw 白板
===========================

基于 Excalidraw 的 CodeExpander 插件。

用于绘制手绘风格图表的虚拟协作白板。
